channel.title: The Dig — Calibration, tuning and drift
channel.description: Papers relevant to operating, benchmarking, integrating and using a semiconductor spin-qubit quantum computer of at least 16 qubits that is co-located with and integrated into an HPC system. Today's arXiv announcement, ranked against the Calibration, tuning and drift preset. Today’s ranked reading list covers three arXiv papers: 2611.34481 is the most directly useful, presenting a high-throughput GPU decoder for quantum bivariate bicycle codes under circuit-level noise that speaks to offloading QEC decoding to HPC resources; 2611.33590 offers a scalable silicon spin-qubit architecture with logical operations but lacks near-term calibration, benchmarking, or HPC-integration detail for a 16-qubit machine; and 2611.33665 describes a scalable FPGA Union-Find decoder that may inform future QEC/HPC offload work but is not directly about spin-qubit operation or the current machine.
